decisions.reason: As a desk system built on the firm's core office offer and aligned with flexible workplace demand, it has good strategic fit and enough remaining upside to justify its carrying cost.

A chair family is close to the core portfolio and can be leveraged through existing design, production, and sales capabilities, so management would likely retain it unless performance clearly disappoints.

Floor cushions are a more niche add-on within a already broad range, and with several stronger adjacent options the firm is likely to reallocate attention if this concept has not clearly proven itself by now.
The upholstered sofa fits the firm's premium living and lounge positioning well, and its explicit design-led launch suggests a committed offering whose option value remains attractive.
A high standing table matches the firm's workplace and conference orientation and benefits from current demand for adaptable work settings, making continuation more likely than withdrawal.

Because the rug collection is the most distant from the established offer, its strategic fit is weaker and management is more likely to free resources for core furniture lines and nearer-term developments.
